title: Magic/Mystic Starter Timeline
summary: A relic-discovery template with Lens scans, research Index pages, starter missions, mystic ambience, safe artifact hints, and map signals.
body: Use this card to connect the first 10 minutes, first 30 minutes, and first 2 hours for Magic/Mystic generated packs.
steps: Read the Relic Basics Index page.
Scan the first relic clue with Lens.
Open the artifact safety tutorial card.
Track a relic signal on HoloMap.
Complete the relic scan starter mission.
